thread:
elaine: heads-up — APAC-euc1 is seeing increased pod churn and GPU attach failures starting ~16:02 UTC. dashboard shows node.evictions spiking and attach errors: `AttachVolume: device busy`. request latency for realtime routes up ~2.3x.

sanjay: oncall. digging into kube events now. are we seeing correlated network flaps or just disk/attach? any recent maintenance?

jamie: no maintenance scheduled. I see BGP session resets on two leafs around 16:01:27 that coincide with evictions. network team alerted?

ops-bot: Incident INV-2026-1345 created by sanjay. Severity: P2. Notifying infra-oncall and routing team.

maria: adding perf traces. looks like GPU attach RPCs are timing out at ~12s, then kubelet triggers eviction path. we should avoid hard evictions for short attach timeouts — that's causing cascade.

kevin: runtime note — we have a kube eviction policy that triggers on `ContainerRuntimeUnavailable` after 15s. maybe tighten backoff and let attach retry a bit longer for GPU volumes. cost tradeoff: more pending pods but fewer evictions vs capacity pressure.

elaine: agreed. short-term mitigation: 1) disable aggressive evictions in euc1 2) set routing weight to shift 25% of realtime traffic to APAC-edge-2 and EU-west spare pool 3) pre-warm two g4 instances in nearby region. do we have an automated traffic-smoothing script?

jamie: I can run the smoothing shift. CLI: `shiftsvc route set-weight --from euc1 --to apac-edge-2 --percent 25 --dry-run=false`

kevin: i'm pushing a runtime patch to increase attach retry to 45s and suppress eviction for attach-related signals. deploying canary to euc1 slice.

deploy-bot: deployment kevin/runtime-attach-retry v2.3.1 started (canary). 5 pods targeted in slice euc1-slice-3.

maria: after smoothing and canary, evictions stopped increasing. attach timeouts still present but reduced error volume. latency trending back toward baseline.

elaine: ok let's capture concrete runbook changes while fresh. propose a short runbook addendum: "soft-eviction mode for attach failures" and "pre-warm hedging when region saturation > 65%". also add explicit step to shift routing weights incrementally (10% every 2m) to avoid spike-induced oscillation.

jamie: draft runbook snippet below — please review.

```
Runbook: regional attach-failure workflow
- Detect: region_attach_error_rate > 3% for 5m OR node_evictions > 10/min
- Mitigate (0-15m):
  - enable soft-eviction for attach signals: set `eviction.attach_timeout_override=45s`
  - incremental traffic smoothing: shift 10% every 2m up to 30% offloaded
  - pre-warm nearest reserve pool: provision 2x g4-like instances tagged `prewarm-hedge`
- Mitigate (15-60m):
  - if attach errors persist > 15m, route 50% to fallback region + enable degraded quantization profile
  - open cross-team bridge and notify customer-success for impacted customers > SLO
- Post-incident: add telemetry alert for attach_latency_p95 and run a short DR drill quarterly
```

kevin: LGTM. only ask: make `pre-warm` configurable by cost center and cap total prewarm to N=10 unbounded -> to avoid runaway costs.

maria: adding new alert thresholds and grafana panels: `attach_latency_p95`, `attach_fail_rate_5m`, `eviction_rate_1m`. connecting to pager when fail_rate>3% for 10m.

elaine: action items: 1) jamie to commit runbook addendum + playbook YAML (owner: jamie, due: 24h) 2) kevin to roll runtime attach-retry patch to all euc1 slices after 30m canary (owner: kevin, due: 3h) 3) maria to publish dashboards + alert rules (owner: maria, due: 6h) 4) infra to add prewarm caps to provisioning (owner: jamie/infra, due: 48h) 5) ops to run a mini-dry-run of incremental weight shifts next week (owner: sanjay, due: 7d).

sanjay: noted. I'll follow up with post-incident timeline and link to the runbook edit. also recommend we add a small runbook test to every oncall rotation (smoke shift) so runbook steps are exercised.

elaine: thanks all — current status: canary successful, smoothing in effect, monitoring until stable. will reconvene in retro if any regressions. :white_check_mark:
